code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            candidates.append((sum(row.count(grid[r][0]) for row in grid), "row", r))
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            color = grid[0][c]
            candidates.append((sum(row.count(color) for row in grid), "col", c))
    _, axis, cut = min(candidates)
    if axis == "row":
        a, b = grid[:cut], grid[cut + 1:]
    else:
        a = [row[:cut] for row in grid]
        b = [row[cut + 1:] for row in grid]
    rows = min(len(a), len(b))
    cols = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    other = max(common, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in a) + sum(row.count(v) for row in b))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else other for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
'''
path.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform',path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
test_out=mod.transform(test)
